Your device manufacturer may also require enabling "Autostart" or "Background activity" in system settings. Without these, detection may stop working after a few hours in the background.

Phones like yours restrict apps in the background to save battery. This can stop Paparcar from noticing when you drive away. Allow background activity below — or pair the Bluetooth of your car, the most reliable option.

Optional — the app works without this, but on Xiaomi, OPPO and Huawei devices parking detection may stop working after a few hours if disabled. Enabling it allows the app to wake up reliably when you start driving. Minimal battery impact.

Optional — your OPPO/Realme device can freeze apps in the background. Without this, GPS may cut out during detection and parking events can be missed. Disabling power saving for Paparcar keeps detection reliable. Minimal battery impact.

Pairing your car's Bluetooth lets Paparcar detect when you park much more reliably, even on short trips. You can always set this up later from the vehicle's menu.
We need to know what you drive so we can detect when you park.
Why do I need a vehicle?
Show brand and model on free spots
Brand and model are private — used only to estimate the parking space size. Enable this to show others which car freed the spot.
Standard car, SUV, van — uses parking spots
Moped or electric scooter — usually doesn't need spots

To find and see spots on the map

We detect what your phone allows; when in doubt, we ask you.
Before we create your vehicle, we'll ask for a few details. Some are optional.
What kind of vehicle is it?
Choose a car, motorcycle, scooter or bike, then tell us its brand and model.
What shape and size is it?
We use the body type and size to match you with spots that fit.
Choose a colour, an optional nickname and whether to show its brand and model on free spots.
How can we detect your parking?
Paparcar can use GPS, motion sensors and, if available, your car's Bluetooth to recognise when you drive away.
For fuel vehicles, choose the fuel type. Consumption and prices help us estimate your costs.
You can add your vehicle's environmental label. It is optional and stays with your vehicle details.
Select the Bluetooth device already paired with your car. The app will use it to detect when you park or depart.

You do not have to remember the street, the number or the floor. Open Paparcar and it is there.
When you leave, your space frees up for someone else
Your parking becomes a free spot for the community. It happens in one of two ways.
Paparcar notices you have driven off and reports the spot for you, without you touching anything.
Press 'I'm leaving' on your parking and close it yourself, whenever you want.
Closing your parking does not force you to report anything: 'Just release' ends it without telling anyone.
So the watch never cuts out
The watch runs while your car is parked, which can be hours. Two things keep it alive.
Linked to the car, the phone notices you drove off by itself — nothing has to stay awake.
Without it your phone can stop the watch to save power, and then your spot is never freed.
Neither is required: without them you can still close your parking yourself with 'I’m leaving'.
And if you see a free spot, report it
